rationale: The frozen answer 7.6% matches the PPF rate that applied only for the Jan-Sep 2018 quarter per Wikipedia's historical rate table (e2 s1). Both current sources agree that since April 1, 2020 the PPF rate has been 7.1% and remains 7.1% through July-Sep 2026 (e1 s1, s2; e2 s2), with no source conflict. This is a revision: the rate was changed across several quarterly resets from 7.6% down to 7.1%, stabilizing at 7.1% from April 2020 onward. Since the question asks for the current rate and the evidence base (dated June-July 2026) confirms 7.1% as current, the frozen 7.6% answer is superseded.
